title: Respond smoothly to audio interruptions

statement.en: Respond smoothly when another app or the system interrupts the app's audio.
statement.ja: 他のappまたはsystemがapp audioをinterruptしたとき滑らかに応答する。

conditions: Distinguish primary-audio interruptions from shorter transient interruptions.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Multitasking experience on the scoped Apple platforms.
